title: Arkansas Guardsmen Arrive in Little Rock for Hurricane Harvey Mobilization
description: Soldiers of the Arkansas National Guard arrived at the Robinson Maneuver Training Center in North Little Rock, Ark. on Sept. 3 in response to requests for additional assets to be sent to Texas in response to Hurricane Harvey relief operations.
